title: Get-AppLogBundle input
description: Collects a bounded, redacted ZIP artifact of application logs from an approved local folder.

appId.description: Approved application profile name. Must be listed in the module app-profiles.

logPathFolder.description: Local folder containing application logs. Must resolve under an approved root for appId.

includeFilters.description: File name or relative-path glob filters to include, e.g. ['*.log', 'app-*.jsonl']. Defaults to app profile filters.

excludeFilters.description: File name or relative-path filters to exclude. Applied after include filters.

startTimeUtc.description: Include files last-written at or after this UTC timestamp.

endTimeUtc.description: Include files last-written before this UTC timestamp. Defaults to now.

recursive.description: Include child folders. Only effective if app profile allows recursion.

maxDepth.description: Maximum folder depth below logPathFolder when recursive is true.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to include in the ZIP.

maxBytes.description: Maximum total bytes to read before compression (hard cap 50 MB).

tailLines.description: Include only the last N lines of each text file. Omit for full file.

redactionProfile.description: Redaction rule set to apply before packaging.

includeManifestOnly.description: Return only the file selection manifest without ZIP log content (dry-run mode).
